meta.title: Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as an AP Manager on a lower-plan tenant and verify that Dispute Task Assignment to Stakeholders is absent or unavailable.
Assign a dispute to buyer, vendor, warehouse, and finance stakeholders on the lower-plan tenant.
Repeat the assignment on a Growth tenant and compare that the capability is available.
Switch between tenants by plan tier when their company IDs and plan details are not provided.
